title: Mallattoo Dhagaa Gidduu
intro: Biyya gaarreen mana keessatti bocaman keessatti ergamaan tokko mallattoo dinqisiisaa Rabbiin biraa dhufe qabate. Ummanni ragaa gaafate, uumama dhagaa jabaa irraa argate. Garuu of tuuluun isaanii akeekkachiisa sana akka morman isaan taasise, hiree isaanii irratti mallattoo kaa’e.
clues: Ummata mana jireenyaa gaara irraa bocame keessa jiraatutti nan ergame.
Mallattoo akkan fiduuf na qormaataniif, dhagaa irraa gaala tokkon oomishe.
Gaalli bilisaan akka dhuguuf malee akka hin miine isaan ajaje.
Isaanis ajaja didanii akeekkachiisa koo mormuudhaan gaala sana hamstrung.
Adabbiin guyyaa sadii booda akka dhufu beeksise.
Ganama dhohinsi cimaan isaan balleesse, aniifi hordoftoonni koo garuu fayyine.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
